checks.criterion: Inventory only artifacts/build and artifacts/tmp without following symlinks, rechecking live attempt/process ownership and preserving active/latest verified builds, shared caches, unknown files, durable state and evidence.
checks.procedure: Review pinned script confinement/no-follow reads; independently inventory only main build/tmp with fd-relative no-follow directory opens; query current attempts, lstat protected roots, verify current executable hashes and actual process/listener ownership against documented recovery.

checks.criterion: Report truthful eligible/retained/deleted paths and bytes with deterministic retained evidence and devlog; no deletion without all ADR0002 conditions and an explicit coordinator allowlist.
checks.procedure: Verify exact report/script hashes, retained path accounting and timestamped report deltas, empty allowlist and zero deletion operations, scoped durable devlog and retained evidence.
